environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed via AWS CDK with the following runtime constraints: (1) Container filesystem mounted read-only except /tmp with noexec. (2) Calico CNI policy applied via ECS Service Connect proxy sidecar with a deny-all egress baseline and explicit allowlist for only the ALB health check CIDR and the application's DynamoDB VPC endpoint prefix list — the 169.254.170.2/32 link-local credential endpoint is NOT in the allowlist but traffic to it traverses the Calico proxy intercept. (3) Task definition specifies 'readonlyRootFilesystem: true' and drops all Linux capabilities except CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. Note: the Calico policy is enforced at the sidecar iptables level within the task ENI namespace, not at the VPC security group level, so security group rules show permissive egress.

config.runtime: ECS Fargate 1.4.0 with Service Connect (Envoy sidecar)
